why: WF(body exit, scheduler): a requested turn start runs (doStartTurn) unless withdrawn (doDropStart)
WF(body exit): every holder is released
WF only: new offers keep a turn start pending, so the exclusive job can starve
WF, no withdrawals: repeated turns (offer, turn, release, offer...) starve the exclusive job
WF + finitely many new offers: the exclusive job runs
WF + SF(exclusive start): the exclusive job runs
